items.text:
English lesson practice — Lesson-09: Health is wealth
Use the cited NCTB 2026 textbook section where required; textbook/audio not included.
Write a short paragraph about healthy habits using Section E. Do not give medication instructions.
items.explanation:
Healthy habits support our body and mind. We should eat a varied, balanced diet, drink safe water and keep our food clean. Washing hands before meals and keeping our clothes and surroundings clean are useful habits. Regular activity, suitable rest and enough sleep are important too. When I feel unwell, I tell a trusted adult so that I can get appropriate care. I do not take medicine on my own. Different people have different health needs, so a qualified health professional can guide us when necessary. These habits support health, but being ill is never a reason to blame or shame someone.

Addresses the task with relevant details
Uses a clear sequence and connected sentences
Uses suitable vocabulary and comprehensible grammar
Accept original accurate responses; do not require memorisation
Original supportive writing model, not a medical prescription. No drug names, doses or claims that habits guarantee freedom from illness.
